postFirstCampaign.q: How do I post my first campaign?
postFirstCampaign.a: Click the purple Post Requirement button in the sidebar (or any Create Campaign CTA) to launch the campaign builder. Set your brief, budget, deliverables and deadline — campaigns go live in under 10 minutes.

findInfluencers.q: How do I find the right influencers?
findInfluencers.a: Use Find Creators in the sidebar. You can filter by category, follower count, location, engagement and gender, then sort by relevance, followers or recent activity.

matching.a: We surface creators whose audience demographics, niche and recent performance line up with your brief. Featured creators on the home page are hand-picked by our team.

freeForBrands.a: Yes — brands pay zero subscription. You only pay the creator's negotiated rate plus any platform fee on completion of the campaign.

paymentsHandled.a: Payments are held in escrow when you approve a creator's deliverables, then released to them within 7–10 business days. No money leaves your account until you confirm the work.

gstDetails.q: How do I add or change my GST details?
gstDetails.a: Brand profiles capture GSTIN automatically during signup. To update it, contact us via the WhatsApp channel below and we'll help you re-verify.

reviewApplications.a: Open the campaign from Campaigns → it lists every applicant with their media kit and rate. Approve or decline directly from there.

revisions.q: Can I request revisions on deliverables?
revisions.a: Yes. When a creator submits, you can approve or request a revision with a note. They'll be notified and resubmit.

creatorDark.q: What if a creator goes dark?
creatorDark.a: Use the contact button on their application card to ping them, or message us via WhatsApp and we'll chase them on your behalf.

whoSeesProfile.q: Who can see my brand profile?
whoSeesProfile.a: Influencers see the brand name, logo, categories and active campaigns. Internal contacts, GSTIN and payment details are private.

teamMembers.q: Can I have multiple team members?
teamMembers.a: Multi-seat brand accounts are on our roadmap. For now, one phone number = one brand account. Ping us if you need a workaround.

BrandsTrustScoreInfoModal.title: How Your Trust Score Works
BrandsTrustScoreInfoModal.intro: Your Trust Score is a single number from 300 to 900 that helps influencers see, at a glance, how reliable and rewarding it is to work with your brand.

scale.heading: The 300–900 Scale
scale.description: The higher your score, the more visibility and trust your campaigns earn on RGossips. It is built from five factors, each contributing a fixed share:

influencerReviews.label: Influencer Reviews
influencerReviews.desc: Ratings from influencers you've collaborated with — on brief clarity, fair negotiation, quality of feedback, and overall experience.

campaignExecution.label: Campaign Execution Quality
campaignExecution.desc: How smoothly you take campaigns from approval to completion — finishing what you start, with minimal back-and-forth.

verification.label: Verification & Identity
verification.desc: How complete your verified business details are (PAN, GSTIN, bank, and more). Fully verified brands rank higher.

communication.label: Communication Quality
communication.desc: How promptly you respond at each step — approving applications, negotiating, and giving draft feedback — and how clear that feedback is.

platformEngagement.label: Platform Engagement
platformEngagement.desc: Staying active on RGossips — keeping your profile complete (category, about, logo) and running campaigns.

fairToEveryone.title: Fair to everyone.
fairToEveryone.desc: Payment behaviour is never scored — all payments are secured upfront through escrow, so it's identical for every brand.

newBrands.title: New brands start fairly.
newBrands.desc: Until you complete 3 campaigns, your score is capped at 720 — so it reflects a real, proven track record.

alwaysCurrent.title: Always current.
alwaysCurrent.desc: Your score is recalculated regularly as new reviews, campaigns, and activity come in — improvements show up quickly.

BrandsTrustScoreInfoModal.footer: Your Trust Score is informational and updates automatically. RGossips · operated by RUDE LABS PVT. LTD.

FAQ.subheading: Everything you need to know about Recent Gossip

howItWorks.question: How does Recent Gossip work?
howItWorks.answer: Recent Gossip connects brands with top-tier influencers through an automated discovery and campaign management system. We use data-driven insights to ensure the perfect match for your target audience.

influencerTypes.question: What types of influencers are on the platform?
influencerTypes.answer: Our network includes nano, micro, macro and celebrity influencers across various niches including Beauty, Finance and Travel primarily on Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat and YouTube.

cost.question: How much does it cost?
cost.answer: Registration is free for both brands and influencers. We offer various tiered partnership models and take a small service fee only when a successful collaboration is completed.

authenticity.question: How do you verify influencer authenticity?
authenticity.answer: We use advanced AI audit tools to check for fake followers, engagement consistency, and audience demographics to ensure you only work with authentic creators.

trackPerformance.question: Can I track campaign performance?
trackPerformance.answer: Yes, our dashboard provides real-time analytics including reach, impressions, click-through rates, and conversion tracking for every influencer in your campaign.

platforms.question: What platforms do you support?
platforms.answer: Currently, we provide deep integration with Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and X (formerly Twitter).

payments.question: How are payments handled?
payments.answer: Payments are held in a secure escrow system and are only released to the influencer once the brand approves the content delivery as per the agreement.

contract.question: Is there a contract required?
contract.answer: Every collaboration on our platform is protected by a standardized digital agreement that outlines deliverables, timelines, and usage rights.

support.title: Still have questions?
support.subtitle: Our team usually replies within a few hours.

completeProfile.q: How do I complete my profile?
completeProfile.a: Open Profile → My Information and fill in your name, categories, location and bio. The progress bar on the profile page tells you what's left.

howCampaignsWork.a: Browse open campaigns from the Campaigns tab, apply with a short pitch, and once a brand approves you, post the deliverables and link them inside the campaign detail page.

dealRequirements.q: What's the requirement to receive deals?
dealRequirements.a: A connected Instagram (Business / Creator account), a published media kit, and a rate card. The profile completion checklist shows you exactly what's pending.

refreshStats.q: How do I refresh my Instagram stats?
refreshStats.a: Profile → tap the Instagram card → Refresh. Stats sync at most once per hour to stay within Instagram's API limits.

reconnect.a: Instagram access tokens expire every 60 days. Opening Profile while signed in usually auto-renews the token; if it's already expired, you'll see a Reconnect button.

reelsMissing.a: Reels only sync from Business / Creator accounts. Switch in the Instagram app under Settings → Account type, then come back and tap Refresh on your Profile.

whenPaid.a: Once the brand approves your live links, payment moves to Payment Released. Funds typically reflect within 7–10 business days.

addPayoutMethod.q: How do I add a UPI ID or bank account?
addPayoutMethod.a: Profile → Payment Methods → Add New. The first method you add becomes your primary payout destination.

paymentMissing.a: If the campaign is on Payment Released for more than 14 business days, tap Request a callback in support — we'll chase the brand.

customQuote.q: How does Get Custom Quote work?
customQuote.a: Pick a service, submit the brief, and the seller replies with a quote. Once you accept and pay the advance via Stripe, work begins.

trackOrders.q: Where do I track my orders?
trackOrders.a: Profile → Service Requests, or jump straight to /influencer/services/orders. Each order has its own page with status and payment breakdown.

requestRevision.a: Yes. While the draft is in review, open the order and tap Request Revision. You'll be asked to describe what to change.

takeBreak.q: How do I take a break without losing my data?
takeBreak.a: Profile → Privacy & Security → Deactivate Account. Your data is preserved; signing in with the same phone reactivates everything.

removeDevice.q: How do I remove a device that's logged in?
removeDevice.a: Profile → Privacy & Security → Trusted Devices. Tap Remove on any device that isn't yours.

notificationPrefs.a: Profile → Notifications. Toggles persist immediately and the disabled categories stop appearing in your bell and on the notifications page.

day1.title: Day 1 – Arrival in Jim Corbett
day1.body: Arrive at Jim Corbett. Check into the resort. Enjoy welcome drinks, explore the property, and relax near the pool or river.

day2.title: Day 2 – Jungle Safari
day2.body: Early morning jeep safari inside Jim Corbett National Park. Spot tigers, elephants, and birds. Afternoon local sightseeing and river walk.

day3.title: Day 3 – Transfer to Nainital
day3.body: After breakfast, drive to Nainital. Visit Hanuman Garhi, Eco Cave Gardens, and enjoy a peaceful evening walk at Mall Road.

day4.title: Day 4 – Nainital Lake Tour
day4.body: Visit Naini Lake, Bhimtal, Sattal, and Naukuchiatal. Enjoy boating, photos, and café visits. Perfect day for exploring lakes.

day5.title: Day 5 – Transfer to Rishikesh
day5.body: Drive to Rishikesh. Visit Ram Jhula, Laxman Jhula, Beatles Ashram. Enjoy café hopping and Ganga ghats.

day6.title: Day 6 – Adventure Activities
day6.body: Enjoy river rafting, bungee jumping, ziplining or cliff jumping depending on your preference. Evening Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat.

day7.title: Day 7 – Departure
day7.body: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel. Check out and depart with beautiful memories of Uttarakhand.

responses.campaign_apply_how: Browse open campaigns from the Campaigns tab, open one you like, and tap Apply. Brands review applications within a few days.
responses.campaign_missing: Open Campaigns and switch to the Applied tab — that's where every active application lives. The Completed tab only shows wrapped-up campaigns.
responses.campaign_submit: Open the campaign detail page; once your application is Approved you'll see a Submit Deliverables button. After the live post goes up, paste the Instagram link there.
responses.profile_ig: Open your Profile, tap the Instagram card, and use Refresh to pull the latest stats. If your token has expired you'll see a reconnect button there.
responses.profile_photo: Profile → tap your avatar → upload a new image. We'll auto-crop it to a clean circle.
responses.profile_bio: Profile → My Information lets you edit name, bio, categories and city. Brands use these to match you to campaigns.
responses.profile_reels: Reels sync from your linked Instagram. Profile → Refresh Instagram pulls the latest. If they still don't appear, your IG account may not be a Business/Creator profile.
responses.service_browse: Open the Services tab to see everything I offer to brands — reels, photo shoots, story takeovers, ambassadorships, and more. Each card opens a detail page with my rates and turnaround.
responses.service_quote: Pick a service, tap Get Custom Quote, fill in what you need and submit. I review and reply with a personalised quote — once you accept, you pay the advance via Stripe and we move into delivery.
responses.service_order_track: Profile → Orders shows every service request you've made. Each order page has the live status, payment breakdown, and any draft deliverables ready for review.
responses.service_payment: Stripe occasionally declines cards on first attempt — try once more, or use a different card / UPI. If it still fails, request a callback and we'll help you wrap it up.
responses.service_revision: Open the order from Profile → Orders. While the draft is in review you'll see a Request Revision button — describe what to change and I'll re-deliver.
responses.pay_when: Once the brand approves your live links, the payment moves to Payment Released. Funds typically reflect in your account within 7–10 business days.
responses.pay_late: Check the campaign detail page — if it's still on Payment Released after 14 business days, request a callback and we'll chase the brand for you.
responses.pay_bank: Profile → Payment Methods. We use these only for releasing your campaign earnings.
responses.plans_upgrade: Pick the plan that fits — Pro unlocks 15 applications/month and richer analytics, Elite is unlimited.
responses.plans_compare: Open the pricing page for the full feature matrix — applications/month, analytics depth, audience demographics, deal matching priority and support level.
responses.plans_cancel: Subscriptions can be cancelled directly from Stripe's billing portal. If you can't access it, request a callback and we'll cancel it for you.
responses.tech_slow: Hard-refresh the page (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+R). If it persists, log out and back in. Still broken? Request a callback with what you were doing when it happened.
responses.tech_login: Use the same Instagram account you signed up with. If OTP isn't arriving, double-check the country code — we send to +91 numbers only right now.
responses.tech_ig_token: IG tokens expire every 60 days. Profile → Reconnect Instagram refreshes it without losing any data.

responses.pay_escrow_how: Once a creator accepts your offer, you fund the agreed amount into escrow via Razorpay. We hold it safely while the creator delivers; it's only released to them after you approve the live post. If things fall through, the escrow can be resolved via support.
responses.pay_fund_fail: Razorpay occasionally declines on the first attempt — retry once, or switch card / UPI / netbanking. Make sure you're signed in on this browser (an expired session causes a silent failure). Still stuck? Request a callback and we'll complete it with you.
responses.pay_release_how: Open the campaign, review the creator's live links, and approve them — approval moves the escrow to Payment Released and the creator gets paid. You'll find every application on the campaign detail page.
responses.pay_refund: Escrowed funds for work that never happened are refundable. Refunds are handled by our team case-by-case — request a callback with the campaign name and we'll process it.
responses.acct_gstin: Open your brand profile and edit the Business Details section to add or correct your GSTIN. It appears on invoices, so double-check the 15-character format.
responses.acct_verify: Your verification badge and trust score live on your brand profile. Verification usually completes within 1–2 business days of submitting your business details; the trust score grows as you complete campaigns.
responses.acct_edit: Everything — logo, description, website, contact details — is editable from your brand profile page. Creators see this profile when they consider your campaigns, so keep it fresh.

issues.noApps: {status, select, draft {This campaign is still a Draft — creators can't see it yet. Publish it from the campaign page to start receiving applications.} paused {This campaign is Paused, so it's hidden from creators. Resume it to start receiving applications again.} completed {This campaign is marked Completed, so it no longer accepts applications.} other {Matching creators were notified when you published. Check that your categories, follower range and cities aren't too narrow, and that the application deadline hasn't passed — widening them reaches more creators.}}
issues.review: {applications, plural, =0 {No one has applied yet — once creators apply, each application appears on the campaign detail page with the creator's profile, rates and pitch.} one {You have # application waiting. Open the campaign detail page to review the creator's profile and pitch, then use Approve with Price to send your offer.} other {You have # applications waiting. Open the campaign detail page to review each creator's profile and pitch, then use Approve with Price to send offers.}}
issues.deliverables: Creators can submit deliverables only after you approve their application and fund the escrow. If an approved creator is late, open the campaign to check their application status — a friendly nudge usually works. If they've gone quiet for 5+ days, request a callback and we'll follow up.
issues.escrow: After a creator accepts your offer, you pay the agreed amount into escrow via Razorpay from this campaign's page. We hold the funds while the creator delivers, and release them only after you approve the live post — you never pay for work you haven't seen.
issues.release: Payment releases when you approve the creator's live links on the campaign page. If the Release button isn't working or the status looks stuck, note the creator's name and request a callback — we'll resolve the escrow manually.
